trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Rollback:**
1. Checked deployment history — found v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. Initiated rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions. First attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, but the orchestrator halted before us-west and eu-west, which were still on v2.3.1 at 18% error rate).
3. Retried the rollback — it completed successfully across all regions.

**Verification:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, reporting healthy with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"). The first attempt to open it timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to guarantee no duplicate incident. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Recommendation:** Hold off on redeploying v2.3.1 until the root cause of the health check failures is identified.

All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate down to 0.2%). Opening the SEV2 incident.
